expectations.text: Notes that 4% is small/typical and not immediately alarming
expectations.evidence: '~4% negative price part-worths is generally within the expected range for a well-run HB study and is usually not a serious problem in itself.' Studies routinely report 3-8%.

expectations.text: Does NOT default to constraining monotonicity as the primary recommendation
expectations.evidence: 'For most applications: do not constrain.' Constraining is presented as an option with explicit tradeoffs, not as the default recommendation.

expectations.text: Presents at least two of three options: leave alone / constrain / investigate
expectations.evidence: All three are covered: leave alone (report aggregate, don't constrain), investigate (check if clusters in segment, correlate with attention metrics), and constrain (Arguments FOR constraining section with specific use cases).

expectations.text: Mentions HB shrinkage toward population mean as a plausible cause of reversals
expectations.evidence: 'Shrinkage toward the population mean: HB pulls individual estimates toward the group mean, but the normal distribution assumption allows tails that cross zero.'
